CustomField.description: Semantic R score based on adjusted recency. 5 is healthiest and 1 is lost/high risk.
CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(Adjusted_Recency__c), NULL, IF( Adjusted_Recency__c <= 1, 5, IF( Adjusted_Recency__c <= 1.5, 4, IF( Adjusted_Recency__c <= 2, 3, IF(Adjusted_Recency__c <= 3, 2, 1) ) ) ) )
CustomField.label: Recency Score
